title: Phytochemical composition comprising Ocimum sanctum and Tinospora cordifolia for immune stimulation
text: Detailed study of Ayurvedic Rasayana botanical combinations reveals that combining Guduchi polysaccharides with Tulsi triterpenes produces non-obvious potentiation of interferon-gamma secretion in splenocyte assays.
